William Van Dort / Mayhew / Paul the Head Waiter (voice)

First they took his daughter. Now they're coming for him.

In Italy... on the Mediterranean... across an ocean... and all over New York!

Tops the Best-Seller! Tops the Play! The One and Only!

She's brown sugar and spice but if you don't treat her nice she'll put you on ice!

A night of passion that will change their lives.

The Smart One Isn't Wearing Any Pants.

Big science has expelled smart new ideas from the classroom...What they forgot is that every generation has its Rebel!

Last time he was nice. This time he's ice!

You're only seventeen once. For Jones Dillon, it's one time too many.

Learn to gain weight by LOSING scruples!

She gives you that WEIRD FEELING.

It's looking at you... from hell!

CECIL B DE MILLE'S SUBLIME MIRROR OF LIFE

A Tale of Three Wise Monkeys

Get ready for a killer holiday.

Four women went to Lourdes in search of a miracle.

A story about the people you love, and how to survive them.

26372: In this adaptation of the critically acclaimed debut novel by Iranian American author Dalia Sofer, a secular Jewish family is caught up in the maelstrom of the 1979 Iranian Revolution.
26628: Sacha is a real seducer, a man with no ties or emotional or professional. Charlotte is a modern and independent woman, but barely has time to care for their three children. 27140: A boxer suffers a serious head injury during a fight, and must deal with the consequences.
Some fights you cannot fight alone
27396: Korean War, winter 1950. In the frozen and snowy area of Changjin Lake, a bloody battle is about to begin between the elite troops of the United States and China.
Do they fall out of the goddamn sky?
27652: When Internal Affairs officer Stéphanie investigates a young man severely injured during a chaotic Paris demonstration and finds no police misconduct, the routine case hits close to home upon her discovering the victim is from her native town.

The only clue is a talking bird Сhatterer [Govorun] that our heroes accidentally took possession of.

Will Gintoki be able to put an end to all this?!
Everything I've wanted to protect is right here with me in spirit.
28420: A chef's life is disrupted by a chime that brings with it an increasing sense of dread.

Tell them that old Indian fighter got his. Tell them I'll kill if I have to. Tell them they'll never take me alive.
29444: A group of Chinese refugees and straggler soldiers, led by a machinist, defend their mountain town, "Gezhi," against a surprise attack by Japanese reconnaissance troops in a desperate fight using civilian ingenuity against a trained military force.

29956: Milo works as a bartender in Berlin and one night gets to know his dream woman Sunny through a series of coincidences. The two meet for a date, but the perfect romantic evening so far.
30212: Corrupt and sleazy entrepreneur Cetto La Qualunque comes back to Italy and "jumps into politics" lest his law-abiding opponent, Giovanni De Santis, is elected as mayor.
I have no dream but I like beaver!
Isabel De Los Santos detta Cosa, la compagna sudamericana

People are roses. Families are rosebushes. Rosebushes need pruning.
30724: A remake of the 1973 action film of the same name.
30980: When the Sultan's first born is taken by an evil sorcerer, Sinbad is tasked with traveling to a desert of magic and creatures to save her.

Adventure called her name... Unfortunately dad answered.

How far would you go to be remembered?
32004: Ram tries to make a synthetic diamond but fails most of the time, leading to scars in his relationship with Priya.  Through a friend, Ram meets priest called Ramachari, who in turn asks Ram to meet Suri. Ram’s life changes after meeting Suri.

A comedy for everyone who ever struggled to love a brother...or strangle one.
32516: An unflinching and deeply personal journey into the life and work of guitarist Eric Clapton told through his own words and songs.
32772: Princess Margaret is travelling incognito to elope with her true love instead of marrying the man her father has betrothed her to. On the high seas, her ship is attacked by pirates who know her identity and plan to kidnap her and hold her for a king's ransom.
Yo-Ho HOPE and a Cargo of Laughs!

Most romantic version of love pain

She has just witnessed a murder that hasn't happened yet.

NEVER HAVE THE STARS LOOKED DOWN...ON AN ADVENTURE LIKE THIS !

When There's No Where Else to Turn to.

Henry Dalio, first owner of Jappeloup

Father and son related by BLOOD!!! EVERYONE'S BLOOD!!

The rise and fall of a beauteous actress

To Stop This Mutha Takes One Bad Brutha

Story of theatrical troupe that travels through the Old West.

The most fantastic undersea odyssey ever filmed.

The story behind the life of one of the greatest basketball players of all time.

One gang of runaways. One secret mission. One pawsome adventure!

It's hard to rock 'n roll when you're knee deep in rubber erasers!

They must pay for his sins

Would you forge love letters to save your life?

The strong ones take, the weak ones give.

A comedy for the incurably romantic.
